candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Observability-matched validation routing: map each failure class to an independent detector at the modality/stage where that failure becomes observable, and gate scientific promotion on the conjunction of those checks rather than one universal verifier.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: AI CFD Scientist reports a controlled planted-failure ablation in which a VLM field-level verification gate catches 14/16 silent failures that passed solver-level checks. The released ablation driver explicitly constructs 20 controlled cases (four failure categories across four flow types plus four controls), post-hoc perturbs outputs, renders diagnostic figures, runs the same production VLM verifier, and aggregates recall/precision. Public paper-derived results show perfect recall for missing-deliverable, wrong-magnitude, and broken-postprocessing cases but only 2/4 for convergence-not-settled; consistently edited endTime can make a truncated run look visually complete. Thus a field-image verifier adds an orthogonal failure channel but cannot substitute for deterministic temporal/residual/QoI-drift checks.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: A robust autonomous-science promotion gate should be a routed detector set, not a monolithic judge: provenance/solver/runtime checks for machine-state failures, deterministic convergence/drift tests for temporal adequacy, artifact/render checks for missing/corrupted deliverables, field-level visual/physics checks for spatial validity, and claim-level evidence checks before writing. Recovery action should be tied to the detector that fired.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Direct planted-failure evidence in one CFD agent system under one production VLM call and 20 constructed cases. It supports observability-matched multi-gate design, not the exact detector stack or thresholds for all science domains. The published ablation also flags all four clean controls in the reduced interpret-mode harness, so false-positive calibration remains an explicit requirement.

evidence_refinements: Candidate 027 (artifact-grounded self-review closure): F.4 Uncorrected Self-Awareness is not concentrated in one system. The released AutoResearchEval matrix reports 660/800 total hits and per-100-system counts of 82, 84, 87, 84, 84, 92, 87, and 60 across the eight harness/model combinations. This strengthens the claim that failure-to-act-on-self-identified-problems is a cross-system control-loop deficit, while still not demonstrating that a mandatory closure controller fixes it.

AutoResearchEval release audit: the public repository exposes the artifact-aware judging/reconstruction/verification implementation and the public data release exposes 800 rollouts plus task metadata, but an exact per-trajectory ARFT-label/actionability corpus was not located in the visible GitHub/HuggingFace file tree during this pass. Therefore the fraction of F.4 cases that were concretely repairable by a later tool action cannot yet be quantified from the released artifacts inspected.

Candidate 028 (turn-level credit): Faraday's direct late-checkpoint ablation supports a training-stability role for its learned per-turn credit, but final capability cannot be attributed to that component alone because the lineage also changes precision, coding tool, horizon, judge averaging, and later task-caption fixes across stages.

Candidate 028 should be narrowed from generic dense turn credit to evidence/progress-grounded credit. In TIPS's matched dense-credit ablation on search-augmented QA, GRPO outcome-only is EM/F1 28.54/35.49, an auxiliary rubric LLM-judge turn signal is 28.23/35.54 (essentially no benefit), while PPO outcome-only is 37.28/45.07 and turn-level information-gain shaping is 40.93/49.49. The authors explicitly attribute weak rubric-judge performance to noisy/surface-form/prompt-drift signals. This does not directly transfer to scientific RL, but it falsifies the broad claim that any learned turn-level judge credit is beneficial.

Faraday innovation-transfer boundary: the paper constructs 20 'imagined' tasks from 10 papers by changing dataset/environment or reversing/changing the claim while keeping the same evaluation interface; the rubric judge prefers Faraday to Codex on 19/20. The authors explicitly state that the rubric judge was not validated on these imagined tasks and provide no human study there. Treat this as promising counterfactual-transfer evidence, not validated novel-discovery performance.

Candidate 022/orthogonal-validation refinement: AI CFD Scientist provides an independent physical-science instantiation of the same principle. A VLM gate catches failures invisible to solver logs, but convergence_not_settled remains only 50% recall, demonstrating that validator independence must be matched to failure observability rather than merely adding another model call.

AI CFD validation precision caveat: the published ablation reports all four clean controls were flagged REVISE in the reduced interpret-mode harness because the generic requirement referenced deliverables not rendered in that subset. This is evidence that safety gates need clean-control calibration and requirement/artifact alignment; high recall alone can create unusable overblocking.
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Cross-system prevalence of AutoResearchEval F.4 is evidence for a recurring failure mode, not evidence that a specific review-closure intervention improves end scientific quality.

Public rollout availability is not the same as public actionable failure labels. Do not infer per-instance repairability until source-qualified annotations or a reproducible classifier mapping is found.

Faraday's final training lineage is multi-change; only the matched late-checkpoint credit ablation supports component-level inference, and even there the measured endpoint is optimization stability under the same learned rubric judge.

TIPS is search-QA, not autonomous science. Use it only to reject generic dense-judge-credit claims and motivate progress/evidence-grounded credit signals, not as direct scientist-agent performance evidence.
AI CFD's VLM gate has strong planted-failure recall but reduced-harness false positives and a clear convergence blind spot. Do not generalize 14/16 into 'VLM verification solves physical validity'.
frontier_additions: Locate source-qualified per-trajectory AutoResearchEval ARFT labels (or the exact release/API containing them), then measure for F.4 whether the agent performed any corrective tool action after the self-identified flaw and whether the final artifact still violated the same issue.
Find a matched autonomous-research intervention that forces severe review findings into re-plan/re-execute/withhold transitions and measures scientific outcome, to test candidate 027 causally.
Inspect Faraday raw training artifacts/logs if released and recover numeric curves/seeds for turn-credit and no-coder ablations; distinguish stability from end-task gain.
Search scientist-agent RL for a matched comparison between free-form LLM-judge credit and artifact/environment-grounded progress credit; prefer external measurements or deterministic evidence deltas.
Inspect AI CFD released ablation artifacts for the four clean controls and exact per-case verdicts, then quantify false-positive mechanism and test a combined visual + deterministic convergence gate.
Search another physical/lab autonomous-science system with planted or naturally occurring failure-class ablations to test observability-matched validation outside CFD.
Seek human or independent-evaluator validation of Faraday-style counterfactual/innovation tasks before treating replication post-training as discovery transfer.
